messages:
alina: Quick ops check — planning to enable quant_profile=int4 on redwood-eta-1.3b for a narrow canary (5%) on chat.generate route. Need safety sign-off + rollback plan. Target criteria: P95 latency delta < +60ms, token cost reduction >= 35%, automatic eval regression < 1% on our canary prompt-set. Thoughts? :eyes:

sam: Can we scope to internal orgs first? Also clarify: 5% of traffic (requests) or 5% of users? I prefer users. Also please add analytics tag so we can filter.

jess: Add a kill-switch flag: quant_int4_enabled and a route-level gate. Also create a datadog monitor: p95_latency > 400ms => notify + auto-disable. I can add the monitor if someone shares the metric name.

matt: oncall ping — what's the rollback playbook? Expected fallback should be redwood-eta-1.3b-fp16 and flip quant_profile back to fp16. Who executes the toggle and who confirms metric check?

alina: ops will run the toggle. Example toggle command (internal feature flag service):
```\ncurl -X POST https://flags.internal.redwood/api/v1/toggle \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOK" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"flag":"quant_profile","value":"int4","audience":"users:5%","routes":["chat.generate"],"expires_in_h":48,"tag":"quant_canary_2026-03"}'\n```
We'll keep canary for 48h, with auto rollback criteria.

sam: Good. I'll scope "users:5%" to external users only (exclude internal and enterprise accounts). I'll add the analytics tag quant_canary=2026-03-int4 and wire up the eval job to run every 30m against the canary prompt set.

deploy-bot: feature_toggle event: quant_profile=int4 applied by ops/alina to audience users:5% on routes=[chat.generate] (tag=quant_canary_2026-03) -- id: ft-1790012345

jess: Smoke tests — run this quick health check:
```\ncurl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood/test/chat.generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN" \n  -d '{"prompt":"Hello","max_tokens":64}' | jq '. | {status:.status,latency_ms:.latency_ms,tokens_in:.tokens_in,tokens_out:.tokens_out,model:.model,quality_score:.quality_score}'\n```
Post sample output if anything > p95 thresholds or quality < 98%.

alina: smoke output after toggle (10:23 PT):
```\n{"status":"ok","latency_ms":182,"tokens_in":64,"tokens_out":120,"model":"redwood-eta-1.3b-int4","quality_score":99.2}\n{"status":"ok","latency_ms":190,"tokens_in":58,"tokens_out":110,"model":"redwood-eta-1.3b-int4","quality_score":99.0}\n```
So far so good. token cost reduction looks ~37% on samples.

matt: LGTM from oncall if smoke stable for 30m. Recommend bump to 20% next day. Ensure client hedging not turned off for this route.

sam: I'll create datadog monitors: p95_latency(chat.generate|quant_canary_2026-03) > 350ms OR error_rate > 0.5% => auto-disable toggle + slack #eng-ml alert. Also set an eval regression monitor: if canary_quality_drop > 1% -> post to #eng-ml and tag ops.

jess: I'll draft a short canary runbook and put it in /docs/canaries/int4-2026-03.md. Runbook will include step-by-step rollback (flip to fp16, clear kv-cache, monitor warmup), and threshold checklist.

alina: thanks everyone — will run this at 10:15 PT and report back at +30m. /cc @matt @sam @jess :thumbsup:
